trap.label: 2º condicional (negociação)
trap.wrong: If you would give me a day off, I would be happier.
trap.right: If you gave me a day off, I would be happier.
trap.why: Em português “se você me desse” usa subjuntivo imperfeito; o brasileiro traduz o se como would. Em inglês, if + Past Simple; would só na cláusula principal.

mcq.q: If you ___ me a day off, I would be happier.

opts: If I knew, I’d tell you.
If I had it, I’d send it.
If I would know, I’d tell you.

fix.wrong: If I will accept, I would earn more.
fix.right: If I accepted, I would earn more.

fix.wrong: If you would pay more, I stay.
fix.right: If you paid more, I would stay.

fix.wrong: If I were have more time, I would help.
fix.right: If I had more time, I would help.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva no 2º condicional: “If I accept, I will earn more.”
rewrite.answer: If I accepted, I would earn more.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva: “If you give me a day off, I will be happier.” (irreal)
rewrite.answer: If you gave me a day off, I would be happier.
